title: Autonomy and Coordination in Intelligent Manufacturing: A Recursive Autonomous Agent Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.05828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intelligent production requires systems to make decisions and organize work according to production goals and operating conditions. It also requires continuous adjustment through feedback. This paper analyzes intelligence in human production organizations from a complex adaptive systems (CAS) perspective. The analysis identifies two coupled mechanisms: individual autonomy and collective coordination. Individual autonomy enables actors to form local decisions using available information. Collective coordination aligns these decisions with shared goals and joint constraints. Learning and adaptation improve both mechanisms over time. A production-system model formalizes how local decision rules and coordination jointly form system decisions. On this basis, we propose the Recursive Autonomous Agent (RAA) framework, which combines goal-driven autonomous agents with a recursive organizational structure. translated_title: 智能制造中的自主性与协调性：递归自主代理框架
translated_abstract: 智能生产要求系统能够根据生产目标和运行状况进行决策并组织工作，同时还需要通过反馈进行持续调整。本文从复杂适应系统（CAS）的视角分析了人类生产组织中的智能。该分析识别出两种相互耦合的机制：个体自主性与集体协调。个体自主性使行动者能够利用可用信息形成局部决策；集体协调则将这些决策与共同目标和联合约束保持一致。学习与适应随时间推移不断改进这两种机制。通过一个生产系统模型，本文形式化了局部决策规则与协调机制如何共同形成系统决策。在此基础上，我们提出了递归自主代理（RAA）框架，该框架将目标驱动的自主代理与递归式的组织结构相结合。目标契约定义了局部目标……
tldr: 本文从复杂适应系统视角揭示了智能制造中个体自主性与集体协调这两种耦合机制，并提出了一种将目标驱动自主代理与递归组织结构相结合的递归自主代理（RAA）框架，用以实现生产系统中的智能决策与组织。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies autonomy and coordination as two coupled mechanisms underlying intelligence in manufacturing from a complex adaptive systems perspective, and proposes the Recursive Autonomous Agent (RAA) framework, which combines goal-driven autonomous agents with a recursive organizational structure.
